params.prompt: Ultra-realistic cinematic product photo, square frame. A heavy antique golden key lying on dark walnut wood, a thin beam of warm light catching its teeth, dust particles in the beam. The key sits in the bottom 35% of the frame; the top 65% is deep warm black, empty for a headline and a large number. Luxury, minimal, high contrast. No hands. Moody chiaroscuro, deep blacks, warm golden light, film grain. No text, no letters, no logos, no blue, no green.
